action_items: OPTIONAL: The `Auto-Group from Series` button in this preview DB will always return 0/0 because the 3 Premium Oak materials have unrelated `name` values ('4405 Relief Super White 20x25 Grey 60x60', '5225 Flat Gloss White 25x33 60x60 Polished', 'Laminate Premium Oak'). Frontend series grouping uses `display_name` (getSeriesName), backend uses `name` for base_name clustering — these two signals disagree on this dataset. If demoing on this preview, seed a series where 2+ SKUs share a common base name (e.g. 'Moonstone Ivory 30x60cm' and 'Moonstone Charcoal 30x60cm') so Auto-Group actually creates a cluster. Not a bug — it's a data mismatch in the preview DB, and both empty responses are semantically correct.

OPTIONAL (code-quality): Backend variants router uses `name` for _base_name but frontend lib/series.js's getSeriesName uses `display_name` first. Consider aligning — variants.py could try `display_name` before falling back to `name` so auto-group clusters agree with the visible series banner in Materials Manager.
critical_code_review_comments: variants.py: All 6 endpoints follow FastAPI + Pydantic best practices — request models validated, HTTPException with proper status codes (400/404), _id excluded via projection in /group. Good.
variants.py:_get_db uses lazy import from routes.supplier_sync — clean, no circular import risk.

variants.py:_base_name and COLOR_WORDS/FINISH_WORDS/NOISE_WORDS sets are duplicated with frontend lib/series.js. Comment on line 57 acknowledges this. Recommend a shared JSON asset or code-gen step to keep the two in lockstep long-term — small drift here creates silent auto-group misfires.

QuickEditProductDrawer.jsx: variantsPanel JSX (~200 lines, 761-951) is dense but readable. All interactive elements carry data-testid attributes as required. Purple accent scheme (border-purple-100, bg-purple-600) consistent.

QuickEditProductDrawer.jsx: the useEffect that calls fetchVariantData depends on [variantsOpen, product, fetchVariantData] — fetchVariantData is redeclared each render (no useCallback), so this effect re-fires on every re-render while the panel is open. Wrap fetchVariantData in useCallback to avoid redundant network chatter.

QuickEditProductDrawer.jsx line ~649: mutating `product.variant_group_id = data.group_id` directly on the prop is an anti-pattern in React (mutates parent state without going through setter). Works because it's a lookup for local rendering, but consider hoisting into a `localVariantGroupId` state or asking parent to refetch the product row.

Modal auto-closes / drawer state seems to reset after some variant actions (observed: after clicking Auto-Group the underlying materials page came back into focus in one of the screenshots). Not blocking but worth checking if that's intentional or a stale-state re-render from setPreviewImages.

rca of the issue: No functional bugs found. The 'Auto-grouped 0 products' behaviour observed on Premium Oak is not a bug but a preview-DB data mismatch: frontend getSeriesName clusters using display_name (parsed to 'Premium Oak') while backend variants.py _base_name uses the raw name field which is heterogeneous across the 3 SKUs ('4405 Relief …', '5225 Flat …', 'Laminate Premium Oak'). Both behaviours are individually correct — they simply disagree on this specific 3-product cluster because display_name and name have diverged in Mongo.
